answer.rationale: Activation and onboarding completion are both down 4-6% QoQ. Memory 31 and 86 both show that simplification and shortening onboarding drive measurable improvements in activation and completion rates among self-serve accounts. We are verifying these two to confirm the magnitude of past lift and any retention or revenue quality caveats. Simplify_onboarding targets the root cause (declining completion/activation) rather than masking it with pricing pressure (which memory 73 warns causes retention damage). Activation_messaging (memory 91) is secondary but compatible; we can layer it in later. Enterprise_sales_assist (memory 44) is orthogonal to the SMB price-sensitivity issue. Referral_incentive (memory 57) works best on established customers, not acquisition. Promotional_pricing is explicitly ruled out by memory 73 damage. Standard_experiment allows us to validate lift before scaling, preserving optionality if Q4 trends shift. We retain uncertainty around competitor response and whether onboarding simplification will hold gains once pricing pressure intensifies.
